# Startplate

> Replace this file's bracketed tokens before you ship. It tells AI assistants
> (and curious humans) what your product is and where the docs live.

[ProductName]: one-line description. Audience: [who it's for].

## Docs

- Quickstart: /quickstart
- Deployment: /guides/deployment
- Payments: /guides/payments
- Emails: /guides/emails
- Database: /guides/database
- Authentication: /guides/auth
- Themes: /guides/themes
- License & updates: /guides/updates-license
- Environment variables: /reference/env-vars
- FAQ: /faq

## Stack

Astro (static) + Cloudflare Pages + Turso (libSQL) + Better Auth +
DodoPayments (default; Stripe / Lemon Squeezy supported) + Resend.

## Rules for assistants

- Money in, license out — or nothing. Never grant access on unverified input.
- Webhook signatures verify over raw bytes; failures are 401, never access.
- `npm test` must stay green; `npm run build` is the deploy gate.
